title: Synthesis of geochronologic research on Late Pliocene to Holocene emergent shorelines in the lower Savannah River area of southeastern Georgia, USA
citation: Markewich, H.W., Pavich, M.J., Mahan, S.A., Bierman, P.R., Alemán‑González, W.B., and Schultz, A.P., 2021, Synthesis of geochronologic research on Late Pliocene to Holocene emergent shorelines in the lower Savannah River area of southeastern Georgia, USA: U.S. Geological Survey Open File Report OF-2021-1015, map scale 1:555,500.
notes:
Study area is the lower Savannah River area of southeastern Georgia; map units are those of Lawton and others (1976) Georgia map. Chemistry, particle-size and Be-10 table rows not recorded individually. Figure 2 map text is garbled; only legend text used. Borrow-pit logs recorded only in part (selected horizons).
Georgia study area (lower Savannah River area). Core logs (figs. 7, 8) are drafted columns; depths of individual layers cannot be tied reliably to descriptions in the text layer, so intervals give unit and description only. Particle-size and chemistry tables 9-17 not recorded. References: only those relevant to South Carolina or to the units described were recorded; general method references skipped.
